died.name: William Woodville
died.cause: to a carpenter he had summoned to measure him for his coffin; final recorded words
died.last_words: I shall not live more than two days, therefore make haste.

died.name: Ludwig van Beethoven
died.cause: being informed that his publisher had gifted him 12 bottles of wine

died.name: Harry C. Egbert
died.cause: to General Loyd Wheaton after being mortally wounded during the Battle of Malinta in the Philippine–American War
died.last_words: Good-by, General; I'm done. I'm too old.

died.name: Cecil Rhodes
died.last_words: So little done, so much to do.

died.name: An Jung-geun
died.desc: Korean independence fighter and assassin of Ito Hirobumi
died.last_words: When the day comes that I hear of Korea's independence in heaven, I will dance and shout 'Hurrah!'

died.name: Sarah Bernhardt
died.last_words: How slow my death agony is.

died.name: Montserrat Grases
died.last_words: Little Virgin: How much I love You! When are You coming for me?

died.name: Noël Coward
died.cause: to Graham Payn, his life partner, and Cole Lesley, his secretary, while going to bed the night before he died
died.last_words: Good night my darlings. I'll see you tomorrow.

born.name: Thomas de Mahy, Marquis de Favras
born.last_words: I see that you have made three spelling mistakes.

born.name: Edward Bellamy
born.desc: American author, journalist and political activist
born.last_words: What can happen to me? I can only die.

born.name: A. E. Housman
born.cause: to his doctor, who had just told a risqué joke
born.last_words: Indeed – very good. I shall – have to repeat – that – on the Golden Floor.
